name: Omni View Central & South America
tagline: Central and South America, one region deep, every day.
description: Omni View Central & South America is one of the Nerra Network's regional desks: Central and South America, one region deep, every day. The Lead, the stories from across the region, the region's meeting point with the wider world, one contested question with the strongest case on each side, and one measurable sign of progress. Read by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — the stories are chosen and written by software from named newsrooms, every item names its source, and every claim is attributed.
